class.name: NNSTTransition
class.brief_description: Defines a transition from its parent state to another state or history node.
class.description: Add as a child of a state ([NNSTTickedNodes]) to switch to [member to], or directly under [NNSTRoot] for fallback event transitions. Set [member event_name] to trigger the transition via [method NNSTBranchNodes.send_event], or leave [member event_name] empty for an automatic transition triggered on state entry and whenever its [member guard] conditions change. Optionally add a [member guard] resource to gate the transition and [member delay_in_seconds] to wait before taking it.

method.name: evaluate_delay
method.description: Evaluates [member delay_in_seconds] (as a number or blackboard expression) and returns a non-negative delay in seconds.

method.name: take
method.description: Triggers this transition directly from code while its parent state is active, skipping [member guard]. Set [param immediately] to [code]false[/code] to honor [member delay_in_seconds]. Returns [code]true[/code] if applied or queued.

method.name: get_supported_trigger_types
method.description: Returns the bit mask of [enum NNSTRoot.TriggerType] flags that can trigger this transition.

method.name: is_triggered_by
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this transition responds to the given [enum NNSTRoot.TriggerType] flag.

method.name: evaluate_guard
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member guard] is unset or currently satisfied.

members.member: Delay in seconds before taking the transition. Accepts a number or an expression referencing blackboard keys. Cancelled if the parent state exits first.
Case-sensitive event name that triggers this transition. Leave empty to make the transition automatic.
Optional [NNSTGuard] that must be satisfied before this transition is taken.
Path to the destination [NNSTTickedNodes] state or [NNSTHistory] node.

signal.name: taken
signal.description: Emitted right before the transition executes (after any delay elapses).
